name: anli
description: 案理（AnLi）· 律师案件协作平台

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green --restart-tries -1 --restart-after 2000 --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.stop: pkill -f 'tsx watch src/index.ts'; pkill -f 'node dist/index.js'; pkill -f 'concurrently'; pkill -f 'vite/bin/vite.js'; kill -9 $(lsof -tiTCP:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN) 2>/dev/null; kill -9 $(lsof -tiTCP:5173 -sTCP:LISTEN) 2>/dev/null; echo 案理前后端已全部停止
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
